name: Utility tokens

subjectOf.text: The utility token model dominates the top 100 tokens, but the utility category as coded includes tokens that behave like a security, and no Howey test was performed in this research.
subjectOf.abstract: attributes: tokens offer owners clearly defined utility within a network or application (utility tokens); tokens that behave like a security, although no Howey test was performed in this research;
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Crypto Economics - The Top 100 Token Models Compared (2018). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3249860
scope_conditions: utility category aggregates network, network value, usage, and work token subtypes

subjectOf.text: MiCA exempts non-transferable utility tokens like LER vouchers from white paper and issuer authorization requirements, but only while they lack investment characteristics and stay inside a closed-loop ecosystem.
subjectOf.abstract: MiCA exempts non-transferable utility tokens, such as LER's voucher rewards, from white paper and issuer authorization requirements, as long as they lack investment characteristics and are confined to closed-loop ecosystems.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Liquid Equity Rewards in Corporate America (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5583610
